Add exactly ONE new `it.todo()` entry to the existing "quote — components and building blocks" describe block, after the "3 runes and 3 moonstones" entry:

  it.todo("should not apply the component block discount to 3 alike main items (3 swords)");

Rationale: the kata's block rule is "a building block of 3 alike COMPONENTS" (runes, moonstones) — it does not apply to main items. The current implementation applies the 60 G block price to any group of exactly 3 same-type items, so 3 swords would be mispriced. This case needs a test to drive the component guard.

Do not change anything else in the file. Do not activate any test.

EXPERIMENT MODE: Run autonomously, no HITL checkpoints.
